🚀 Publish Settings

Connect this editor to your GitHub repo once, and the Publish button will push your edits straight to the live site. Your token is stored only in this browser, on this device.

Need a token? Create one here — set repository access to just she_social_web, and under Permissions give Contents: Read and write.
